# Square Studio

> Luxembourg-based UI/UX and branding studio specializing in Framer websites, digital products, and design systems.

Square Studio (Square Studio s.à.r.l.) is a design studio based in Luxembourg City. It works with SaaS, fintech, and B2B companies on product design, visual identity, and high-performance marketing sites built in Framer.

- FAQ: https://www.squarestudio.design/faq

## Services

- UI/UX design for web and mobile products
- Framer website design and development
- Design systems and component libraries
- Brand identity and visual design
- Prototyping and design-to-development handoff
